name: pixgin
description: Pixgin image campaign generator with Agent Free and Agent Pro on Replicate.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && node scripts/build-editor.mjs
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.editor.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/browser-components.test.js tests/generation-jobs.test.js tests/deployment-contract.test.js tests/image-prompt.test.js tests/replicate-resize.test.js tests/server-contract.test.js tests/supabase-storage.test.js tests/supabase-auth.test.js tests/design-document.test.js tests/design-ai.test.js tests/design-api.test.js tests/design-layers.test.js
